_comment: Real Tailscale peers of this platform. Replaces the generated 100-node tier table, which enumerated one subnet (100.93.191.0/24) and had never contacted any address. Each entry is probed on TCP 8022 at startup; 'reachable' in the API means that probe completed, nothing else.
_transport_note: None of these expose a file-transfer path today: :8022 is closed on all of them, sshd is not running on carruth-macpro5-1, and 100.82.16.43 times out on 22. Federation probing works; federation FILE SYNC does not, and must not be claimed until a transport answers.
